_readme: Anglická verze webu (/en/). Build (build/build.mjs, renderHome) vezme českou šablonu build/templates/index.template.html a nahradí v ní každý klíč z 'homepage' anglickým textem. Když se český text v šabloně změní, klíč přestane sedět a build SPADNE s názvem chybějícího textu: pak uprav klíč i překlad tady. Zbylá čeština v anglické stránce build také zastaví (výjimky = vlastní jména v '_allow'). Reference a case studies ze Sheetu se překládají podle id (references/cases); co tu chybí, na anglické stránce není. Pravidla obsahu platí i v angličtině: bez dlouhé pomlčky, bez vymyšlených čísel. Čtenář = klient (HR a management zahraničních firem), často ne rodilý mluvčí: krátké věty, bez idiomů, britský pravopis. Fáze 2: 'industries' = stránky /en/industries/ (klíč = český slug z obory-stranky.json, '_zdroj' = otisk české předlohy; když se česká změní, build spadne a vypíše nový otisk), 'roles' = anglické názvy rolí pro /en/roles/ (klíč = název z /co-obsazujeme/; role bez překladu se nezobrazí a build ji vypíše), 'labels' = obory/úrovně/kraje u pozic, 'ui' = texty stránek. FAQ: assets/data/ai-legibility/faq.en.md.

homepage.<p class=\"proof-intro rv\">Klienti nás: Clients do not value us for the number of CVs. They value accurate profiles, candidate notes they can use and a clear view of what is really happening in the market.
homepage.<blockquote class=\"proof-quote\">„Ani j: “Not a single candidate was completely off target.”
homepage.<blockquote class=\"proof-quote\">„Pozná: “We later used the notes on the candidates in our interviews.”
homepage.<blockquote class=\"proof-quote\">„Uchaz: “Candidates we thought did not exist on the market at all.”
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\">Když inzerce nesta: When job ads are not working, another ad will not help.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\">Většina klientů se: Most clients contact us after they have tried the usual channels and seen the active candidates. At that point, we do not post another ad. The people you need usually have a job, do not apply and do not appear through the usual channels. But they are willing to talk about the right offer.
homepage.<p class=\"rv\">Nejtěžší nebývá najít ře: The hardest person to find is rarely the director. Directors tend to be visible. The hardest is the specialist who has a job, is not looking and would probably ignore a standard offer. That is why they never answer a job ad.
homepage.<div class=\"kicker rv\">Jiný druh práce: A different kind of work
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\">Běžná agentura pra: A typical agency works with whoever applies. We work with the people who never would.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\" style=\"margin-top:: The active part of the market is made up of people who are looking right now, answering ads or open to offers. We also work with people who have a job, do not apply and never appear through the usual channels. They have a strong profile not because they want a new job, but because they are good at the one they have. We approach them directly.
homepage.<blockquote>„Konzultanti dokázali přesně: “The consultants identified exactly which companies were likely to employ a suitable candidate for the role.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Služby Sintery využíváme pr: “We use Sintera for its deep knowledge of the labour market and its wide reach across disciplines and positions.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Ve velmi krátkém časovém ho: “In a very short time, we filled a position we had been trying to fill for a long while.”
homepage.<blockquote>„I přes velmi specifickou po: “Even though the position was very specific, the vast majority of candidates met the minimum requirements we set in the brief.”
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\">Když roli špatně p: Describe the role the wrong way and the right people slip through the net.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\" style=\"margin-top:: The market may use a different name for the role than the one you have in mind. One badly worded requirement is enough to lose a candidate who can do four of the five things you need. Not because they are unsuitable, but because the brief was aimed in the wrong place.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\">Proto nejdřív zpřes: So we start by clarifying who you really need: what the person must be able to do, what experience they must have, what environment they will work in and how you will know they are succeeding.
homepage.<blockquote>„Stačil krátký hovor, aby by: “A short call was enough to describe the position properly. Sintera understands the personality profile the candidate needs.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Jasně strukturovaný přístup: “A clearly structured approach reduced the delays caused by an unclear or misunderstood brief.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Profily kandidátů s velkou: “The candidate profiles matched the positions we were looking to fill with great accuracy.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Kandidáti doporučení k poho: “The candidates recommended for interview matched our requirements in experience, knowledge and expectations for the role.”
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\" style=\"max-width:: Tools open doors. Experience decides which ones to knock on.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\">Máme vlastní search: We have our own search infrastructure: tools we largely build ourselves, our own methods and know-how developed over years. It is not rocket science. But not everyone can build it and use it well, day after day. Just as you have a production line for your product, we have a production line for finding your person.

rotor.rot_01: We present candidates with a clear reason to talk to them. Not profiles that leave you guessing why they were sent.
rotor.rot_02: When a search is precise, the company does not sort through a pile of irrelevant CVs. It talks to people who make sense.
rotor.rot_03: Sometimes the goal is not more applications. It is finding people who never appear, because they already have a job.
rotor.rot_04: A candidate should not be just somewhere near the brief. There should be a clear reason why they are worth an interview.
rotor.rot_05: A good search delivers more than CVs. It delivers context that helps the company decide faster and on the facts.

ref_zf_passive_safety.quote: 99% of the candidates presented go straight to interview.
ref_zf_passive_safety.long: For quality roles in automotive, the cooperation is set up so that the candidates who reach the shortlist match the requirements. There is no sorting through irrelevant CVs, and 99% of the candidates presented go straight to interview. Most of the positions are filled through Sintera.

ref_sitel.role: Data centre technician, field response technician, site manager
ref_sitel.quote: We also received candidates who had seemed unreachable on the market.
ref_sitel.long: The written candidate presentations are thorough, clear and accurate. The candidates match the company's specific needs, expertise and budget. Within a short time, Sintera also reached people who had seemed unreachable on the market.

ref_alstom.quote: Not a single candidate presented was outside the scope of the role.
ref_alstom.long: Sintera delivers precisely targeted candidates to the procurement department. None of them fall outside the scope of the role. The candidate notes include detailed comments on each profile, and the communication helps define the expectations for the position more precisely.

ref_windmoller_holscher.quote: The candidate notes include Sintera's comments and the candidate's salary expectations.
ref_windmoller_holscher.long: Communication throughout the cooperation is efficient and useful. The candidate notes include Sintera's comments, relevant information about the position and the person, and their salary expectations. So the company gets more than a CV: it gets the context for a decision.

ref_jtekt_czech_republic.quote: Several candidates often move on to the next rounds.
ref_jtekt_czech_republic.long: The candidate profiles have a clear structure, are easy to read and contain what matters for the decision. The candidates match the requirements of the position, and several of them often move on to the next rounds.

ref_nestle_cesko.role: Product and process specialist, safety technician
ref_nestle_cesko.quote: The profiles matched the agreed brief very closely.
ref_nestle_cesko.long: The profiles match the agreed brief very closely. Fast communication with the candidates keeps the selection moving without unnecessary delays. After a few interviews, the company selected a candidate for the product and process role.

ref_aisan_industry.quote: The selection process ended sooner than expected.
ref_aisan_industry.long: The team works professionally and in a clearly structured way, which reduces the delays caused by an unclear brief. Even for a very specific position, most candidates met the requirements, and the selection process ended sooner than expected.

ref_siemens_energy.quote: The notes on the candidates were used directly in the interviews.
ref_siemens_energy.long: Communication is fast and pleasant. The notes attached to the CVs are detailed enough to be used directly in the interviews. Of four candidates, two moved on to the second round and both reached the offer stage.

ref_trw_carr.quote: The consultants ask about the real content of the role in detail.
ref_trw_carr.long: The consultants go to the core of the position. They ask what the person will do, which team they will join and how the brief changes during the search. As a result, the search is based on the real context of the work, not just on the job title.

ref_zf_electronics_klasterec.role: SMT, engineering, HR and technical positions
ref_zf_electronics_klasterec.quote: A stable team of consultants keeps its knowledge of the company and the industry.
ref_zf_electronics_klasterec.long: Sintera keeps a stable team of consultants who know the company and the automotive environment. Candidates go through thorough screening, and the profiles highlight the key professional skills expected for the position.

ref_r_s_automotive.quote: Each candidate summary contains everything needed for the decision.
ref_r_s_automotive.long: Long-term cooperation means Sintera knows the company well and chooses suitable candidates. The summary for each person contains everything needed for the decision and works as a practical basis for the selection.

ref_sanborn.quote: The notes summarise the candidate's motivation, availability and salary expectations.
ref_sanborn.long: Sintera helps fill even hard-to-fill positions in a short time. The CVs match the brief, and the introductory note summarises what matters for the decision: motivation to change jobs, availability for interview and salary expectations.

ref_spofadental.quote: A weekly report gives an ongoing view of the search.
ref_spofadental.long: A weekly activity report gives an ongoing view of what is happening in the search. The cooperation is based on a regular supply of profiles and candidate notes that need no corrections.

ref_m_a_s_automation.quote: The profile of the position was understood precisely.
ref_m_a_s_automation.long: The profile of the position was understood precisely. The research of potential candidates is professional and fast. The quality of candidates is above average against the benchmark, and the positions were filled in a short time.

ref_konplan.role: Software developer, design engineer, PLC programmer, project manager
ref_konplan.quote: Even the candidates recommended for interview praise how Sintera deals with them.
ref_konplan.long: Sintera's professionalism is also confirmed by feedback from the candidates themselves after their interviews. The candidate assessments and the notes on the CVs speed up the process of filling the role.

ref_vitesco_technologies.quote: The selected candidate started on the agreed date.
ref_vitesco_technologies.long: Work on filling the position started immediately after the order. Communication is open and efficient. A suitable person was selected from the candidates presented, the contract was signed and the new employee started on the agreed date.

ref_linet.role: Country Manager for India and strategic management roles
ref_linet.quote: The position was filled ahead of the planned date.
ref_linet.long: The consultants identified exactly which companies were likely to employ a suitable candidate. The candidates matched both the requirements and the budget. A position that had been difficult to fill in the past was filled ahead of the planned date.

ref_vyzkumny_ustav_zeleznicni.quote: The profiles match the position briefs with great accuracy.
ref_vyzkumny_ustav_zeleznicni.long: The search is efficient and precisely targeted at the positions required. Profiles arrive quickly, and the candidate notes provide key information for the interview. The cooperation has lasted many years and covers several fields and levels of seniority.

organization.description: Sintera Czech is a recruitment consultancy specialising in direct search for manufacturing and engineering companies in the Czech Republic. It fills skilled trade and technical roles (CNC programmers, machine setters, milling operators, welders, fitters, toolmakers, electromechanical technicians, maintenance technicians), technician and engineering roles (quality, design, process engineering, automation) as well as management and top management. It approaches people directly who have a job and are not actively looking.
serviceType: Recruitment for technical and manufacturing roles
knowsAbout: recruitment in manufacturing and mechanical engineering

cta.h2: Do you have a role you cannot fill?
cta.p: Send us the job description or a few sentences about the role. We will get back to you and suggest how to approach it.

steps: We translate your brief into the language of the market: the real content of the job, the team, the conditions and what makes the role interesting.
We map the companies and positions where suitable people work today.
We approach them directly, including people who are not actively looking for a job.
We present a shortlist with a comment on each candidate: why they match, their motivation, availability and expectations.
ui.stepsNote: We usually present the first candidates matched to your brief within 10 days after we agree on the role profile together. A named consultant is responsible for each search.

rolesPage.h1: From CNC setters and programmers to production directors
rolesPage.p: Sintera does not only look for managers. A direct approach (direct search) makes sense for every role that a job ad will not fill, and in manufacturing and engineering most roles are like this. Below are positions we have filled or are filling now, by level and by field. The open positions themselves are published in Czech.
levels: We look for machine setters, CNC programmers and milling operators, welders, fitters, toolmakers and electromechanical technicians with the same care as for managers. These are exactly the people who have a job, whom companies want to keep and who do not respond to job ads.
Quality engineers, design engineers, manufacturing engineers, PLC programmers, service technicians, buyers, logistics specialists, controllers and HR specialists.
Foremen and production managers, managers in quality, procurement, service and projects, operations and sales directors, and international management roles.

cases.why: Why standard recruitment was not enough
cases.note: This story is based on a client reference. We do not name the company. The field, the type of roles and the region are real.

strojirenstvi-a-vyroba.h1: Direct search in manufacturing and mechanical engineering
strojirenstvi-a-vyroba.desc: We find machine setters, CNC programmers, manufacturing engineers, foremen and production managers by approaching them directly. Good people in production have a job and do not read job ads.
strojirenstvi-a-vyroba.lead: We look for machine setters, CNC programmers, welders, manufacturing engineers, foremen and production managers. We approach them directly, because good people in production have a job and do not read job ads.
proc: An experienced machine setter or CNC programmer is hard for a company to replace. They are not actively looking for a job. When they do consider a change, they decide based on the specific machines, the shift pattern, the commute and the people they will work with. A general ad such as “CNC operator wanted” will not reach them.

It is similar with leadership roles in production. A foreman or production manager who can lead people and also understands the technology is rarely available on the market. These people need to be found and approached, and they need to hear why a change makes sense for them.
strojirenstvi-a-vyroba.jak: We translate your brief into the language of the market: which machines and control systems, what type of production (single-piece or series production), what tolerances and what shift pattern. Based on this, we search in companies where the same work is actually done, and we give candidates concrete reasons to talk to you.

faq.q: Do you fill technical and skilled trade roles, or only management?
faq.a: Both. Most of the production roles we fill are specialists and technicians: machine setters, CNC programmers, welders, manufacturing engineers and fitters. We also look for foremen, production managers and production directors.

faq.q: How quickly will you present the first candidates?
faq.a: Usually within 10 days after we agree on the role profile together. The candidates are matched to your brief.

automotive.desc: We find quality engineers, process and production specialists, maintenance staff, design engineers and managers for automotive suppliers by approaching them directly.
automotive.lead: For automotive suppliers, we look for quality engineers, process and production specialists, maintenance staff, design engineers and managers. We have worked with automotive companies over the long term.
proc: Automotive depends on standards, audits and precise processes. A quality engineer usually needs experience with IATF 16949 and tools such as FMEA or 8D. A process engineer needs experience with the specific technology of the line. People with this combination work for other suppliers and do not respond to job ads.
The second problem is volume. When a job ad brings dozens of CVs that do not meet the requirements, the quality or production team loses time sorting them instead of doing its own work.
automotive.jak: We search in companies with the same type of production and customers. For each candidate we add a comment: what they can do, why they are considering a change, when they can start and what salary they expect.

faq.q: Do you have experience with automotive suppliers?
faq.a: Yes. Sintera's clients include, for example, ZF, JTEKT, Vitesco Technologies, Aisan Industry and R+S Automotive. We fill roles in quality, production, maintenance, development and management.

faq.q: How many candidates will we receive from you?
faq.a: A shortlist of people who match the brief, not a pile of CVs. For quality roles at one of our automotive clients, 99% of the candidates we present go straight to interview.

kvalita-a-zkusebnictvi.h1: Direct search in quality and testing
kvalita-a-zkusebnictvi.desc: We find quality engineers, supplier quality engineers (SQE), test technicians, and quality and laboratory managers by approaching them directly.
kvalita-a-zkusebnictvi.lead: We look for quality engineers, supplier quality engineers (SQE), test technicians and test specialists, quality managers and laboratory managers.
proc: A good quality engineer is most visible when they are missing. People who can handle audits, customer complaints and work with suppliers are busy in operations. They do not look for a change on job portals.

Quality also works differently in every industry. A rail vehicle testing facility has little in common with the inspection of injection-moulded parts. The same job title can mean a completely different person.
kvalita-a-zkusebnictvi.jak: At the start, we clarify whether you need system quality, supplier quality or quality directly in production, and which standards and customers are involved. Based on this, we map the companies where the same work is done.

faq.q: Do you also fill roles for test technicians and laboratories?
faq.a: Yes. Apart from quality engineers and quality managers, we fill roles for test technicians, test specialists and laboratory managers, for example in testing and certification.

faq.q: How do you make sure a candidate really matches the brief?
faq.a: The consultant asks about the real content of the role, the team and the customers, and assesses candidates against this, not only against the job title. For each candidate, the consultant adds a comment on why it makes sense to talk to them.

elektro-a-automatizace.h1: Direct search in electrical engineering and automation
elektro-a-automatizace.desc: We find electrical designers, PLC specialists, robot programmers, electrical engineers and electromechanical technicians by approaching them directly.
elektro-a-automatizace.lead: We look for electrical designers, electrical engineers, PLC specialists, robot programmers, electromechanical technicians and power electronics engineers.
proc: There are few PLC and robot programmers on the market, and they often work on projects that people do not leave halfway through. An electrical designer needs to know specific standards, software and types of projects.

A standard job ad does not show the difference between an electrician and a person who designs switchboards and machine control systems. So the people who respond are mostly those who do not match the role.
elektro-a-automatizace.jak: We clarify the control systems, robots and software, and how much of the work is done on installation sites or at customer sites. We approach people from integrators, machine builders and plants where the same technology is used.

faq.q: Do you also fill roles for integrators and machine builders?
faq.a: Yes. Our clients include machine builders, integrators and manufacturing companies, for example M.A.S. Automation and Konplan, for whom we have searched for design engineers, PLC programmers and project managers.

faq.q: How quickly will you present the first candidates?
faq.a: Usually within 10 days after we agree on the role profile together. The candidates are matched to your brief.

technika-vyvoj-a-konstrukce.h1: Direct search in engineering, R&D and design
technika-vyvoj-a-konstrukce.desc: We find design engineers, development engineers, manufacturing engineers, technical project managers and heads of development centres by approaching them directly.
technika-vyvoj-a-konstrukce.lead: We look for design engineers, development engineers, manufacturing engineers, technical project managers and heads of development and testing centres.
proc: A design engineer or manufacturing engineer with experience in a specific field takes a long time to train, and the company keeps them. Few of them are visible on the market.

When they consider a change, they decide based on the content of the work: which products, which CAD system, and how much is new development compared with changes to existing solutions. A job ad that does not say this will not interest them.
technika-vyvoj-a-konstrukce.jak: We go through the brief in detail: the product, the software, the share of development and production, the work with documentation, and the language. Then we look for people who do the same work elsewhere, and we can tell each candidate exactly what makes the role interesting.

faq.q: Do you also fill development and R&D management roles?
faq.a: Yes. We fill specialist and leadership roles, for example technical project managers in R&D or heads of development and testing centres.

faq.q: What if the brief changes during the search?
faq.a: The consultant adjusts the search to the new profile. Reacting flexibly to a change in the brief during the search is a normal part of the work, not an exception.

servis-a-udrzba.h1: Direct search for service and maintenance
servis-a-udrzba.desc: We find maintenance technicians, electrical maintenance specialists, field service technicians and service managers by approaching them directly.
servis-a-udrzba.lead: We look for maintenance technicians, electrical maintenance specialists, production line maintenance specialists, field service technicians and service managers.
proc: A maintenance technician who understands electrics, mechanics and line control is key for a plant, and the company will not let them go. They rarely look for a change.
A field service technician also needs technical knowledge, a driving licence, often a foreign language and a willingness to travel. It is hard to find this combination through a job ad.
servis-a-udrzba.jak: We clarify the type of equipment, the shift pattern, the share of electrical and mechanical work, and the amount of travel. We approach people from plants and service organisations that look after the same equipment.

faq.q: Do you fill maintenance roles in production as well as field service roles?
faq.a: Yes. We fill maintenance roles in production, both electrical and mechanical. We also fill roles for service technicians and managers who travel to customers in the Czech Republic and in Germany.

faq.q: How quickly will you present the first candidates?
faq.a: Usually within 10 days after we agree on the role profile together. The candidates are matched to your brief.

management-a-executive-search.h1: Executive search: management and leadership roles
management-a-executive-search.desc: We find production managers, operations and sales directors, quality, procurement and project managers, and international managers through a discreet direct approach.
management-a-executive-search.lead: We fill roles for production managers, operations and sales directors, quality, procurement and project managers, and international management roles.
proc: A manager who is leading a team successfully today has no reason to respond to job ads. They will consider a change when someone approaches them personally with an offer that makes sense for their next career step.
For international and strategic roles, the group of suitable people is also small. It is not enough to wait and see who responds. You need to know where these people work.
management-a-executive-search.jak: First, we map the companies and positions where suitable people work. We approach them personally. The client receives a shortlist with a comment on each candidate's motivation, availability and expectations.

faq.q: Is executive search the same as headhunting?
faq.a: Basically, yes. Headhunting is the informal name for approaching candidates directly. Executive search is the form used for leadership and strategic roles. Sintera finds and approaches suitable people directly, instead of waiting for responses to job ads.

faq.q: Do you also fill international roles?
faq.a: Yes. For example, a Country Manager for India for a medical equipment manufacturer, or project, service and sales roles in Germany.

logistika-a-nakup.h1: Direct search in logistics and procurement
logistika-a-nakup.desc: We find buyers, procurement managers, category managers, logistics specialists, dispatchers and analysts by approaching them directly.
logistika-a-nakup.lead: We look for buyers and procurement managers, project buyers, category managers, logistics specialists, dispatchers and logistics process analysts.
proc: A good buyer knows the supplier market, can negotiate and often speaks another language. The company keeps them because they control costs.

In logistics, knowledge of specific processes and systems is what matters. A general “buyer” or “logistics specialist” profile covers very different jobs, so a job ad attracts mostly responses that do not fit.
logistika-a-nakup.jak: We clarify whether it is strategic, operational or project procurement, which material category, which language and which systems. We search in companies with a similar type of procurement and similar suppliers.

faq.q: Do you fill strategic as well as project procurement roles?
faq.a: Yes. We look for procurement specialists and managers, project buyers and category managers, for example for facility management.

faq.q: How quickly will you present the first candidates?
faq.a: Usually within 10 days after we agree on the role profile together. The candidates are matched to your brief.
